messages.content: Can you take an activation funnel analysis?
Yes, taking an activation funnel analysis.
My preference would be a 95% confidence threshold for experiment calls.
Details are in analytics/experiments.py. Deduplication of the double-fired signup event went in this morning. Should we add more coverage? Makes sense, doing that.
Could counting monthly actives on a rolling 28-day window work for us?
Sure, on it. Here's where things stand. Documentation of every metric definition is finished and deployed.
How is an activation funnel analysis going?
I got the dashboard tracking the three north star metrics over the line. Instrumenting the mobile funnel is still owed to the client.
Carry on.
CI is passing. I got the experiment assignment and exposure logging over the line. The fix lives in analytics/segments.sql. The team picked reporting absolute lift alongside relative.
Blockers?
Details are in analytics/cohorts.sql. We might revisit this next quarter.
Carry on.
A segment definition for activated accounts is finished and deployed. Should we add more coverage? A holdout group excluded from all experiments has shipped.
What if we went with excluding internal accounts from every metric?
Sure, on it. Got hit by the active user count differing 12% between two dashboards in staging. CI is passing. We haven't done a qualitative follow-up with churned accounts yet.
Blockers?
A data dictionary for the product team is next up. Sunsetting the legacy dashboard is waiting on us.
How is an activation funnel analysis going?
A funnel from signup through first value is up and working.
